claims.text: A remote scorer Signal automatically scores each individual LLM span, each tool span and the entire conversation.
It guarantees that all three levels receive scores even when the turn has not ended.

issues: S1 says the opposite: Weave scores only completed turns, and individual LLM spans, tool spans and whole conversations aren't remote scoring targets.
The claim of a guarantee of scoring before a turn ends contradicts S1. Scoring starts when a root span ends and emits weave.genai.turn_ended.

Rewrite the answer: a remote scorer signal scores each completed agent turn, meaning a root span that has ended. The worker builds the request from that turn's span, including its messages, after applying the signal's filters and sample rate.
Revise partial or unsupported material claims.
